start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:research-brief-and-study." Keep a person current on one of their goals or any subject they care about: their own AI researches it from public sources (articles, videos, social posts, papers, their own notes), writes a short briefing in which every claim names the exact source it rests on, asks the person a few questions they answer from memory, and, only if they approve the exact words, shares one insight with its sources in their community so anyone, or anyone's AI, can check it.

instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Run workflow:research-brief-and-study" with the input in the worked example.
2. The AI starts it with tool:start-a-recipe-run (row workflow:research-brief-and-study) and works through its steps in order: research, briefing, study, insight, share.
3. Read what each step hands back; the last step is share.
